notes: Held at Fuse at Mason Square, 3401 Fairfax Dr, Arlington, VA. It filled up in 2026, so apply early next year.
name: ACCESS Academy AI Summer Camp
what_you_do: A free week-long camp. You learn the basics of machine learning with hands-on projects. You build simple tech prototypes. You also share your own ideas in teams.
who_can_apply: Rising 9th to 12th grade students in the Commonwealth of Virginia.
pay_detail: No cost to students. Lunch provided daily. You provide your own transportation.
duration: One week, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. daily (2026 sessions: July 13-17, July 20-24, July 27-31)
deadline_text: 2026 application closed because spots filled; applicants were told their week starting the week of June 8, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the ACCESS Academy page when it opens again. If you have questions, write to Dr. Roberto Pamas. He is the ACCESS Academy Director. His email is rpamas@gmu.edu.
